meanings.en: a time when an important change happens
meanings.exampleEn: The election marked a watershed in the country's history.
meanings.exampleTr: Seçim, ülkenin tarihinde bir dönüm noktası oldu.

meanings.en: an area of land that separates rivers flowing into different systems
meanings.exampleEn: The mountain ridge forms a natural watershed between the two rivers.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağ sırtı, iki nehir arasında doğal bir su ayırım çizgisi oluşturur.

meanings.en: in a way that is too bad to be justified or forgiven
meanings.exampleEn: The staff were inexcusably rude to the customers.
meanings.exampleTr: Personel, müşterilere affedilmez biçimde kaba davrandı.

meanings.en: without someone accompanying or protecting you
meanings.exampleEn: Unescorted children are not allowed into the club.
meanings.exampleTr: Refakatsiz çocukların kulübe girmesine izin verilmez.

meanings.en: impossible to explain or understand
meanings.exampleEn: For some inexplicable reason, the machine stopped working.
meanings.exampleTr: Açıklanamaz bir nedenle makine çalışmayı durdurdu.

meanings.en: not able to be explained or understood
meanings.exampleEn: She felt an unexplainable sense of dread.
meanings.exampleTr: Açıklanamaz bir korku hissetti.

meanings.en: able to be explained or understood
meanings.exampleEn: His behaviour is easily explicable if you know his background.
meanings.exampleTr: Geçmişini bilirsen davranışı kolayca açıklanabilir.

meanings.en: not made weaker by having water or another liquid added
meanings.exampleEn: Don't drink the undiluted syrup; mix it with water first.
meanings.exampleTr: Seyreltilmemiş şurubu içme; önce suyla karıştır.

meanings.en: complete and pure, not mixed with anything else
meanings.exampleEn: The news was met with undiluted joy.
meanings.exampleTr: Haber katıksız bir sevinçle karşılandı.

meanings.en: unfriendly and not wanting to be close to other people
meanings.exampleEn: People find her standoffish, but she's just shy.
meanings.exampleTr: İnsanlar onu mesafeli buluyor ama aslında sadece utangaç.

meanings.en: past tense and past participle of unwind; to undo something that is wound, or to relax
meanings.exampleEn: She unwound the bandage from his arm.
meanings.exampleTr: Bandajı kolundan çözdü.

meanings.en: relaxed after a period of work or tension
meanings.exampleEn: He unwound after work with a long walk.
meanings.exampleTr: İşten sonra uzun bir yürüyüşle rahatladı.

meanings.en: past tense of unwrap; to remove the paper or covering from something
meanings.exampleEn: The children unwrapped their presents excitedly.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar hediyelerinin ambalajını heyecanla açtı.

meanings.tr: kesin bir şey söylemeyen, taraf tutmayan, çekingen
meanings.en: not expressing an opinion or decision clearly
meanings.exampleEn: He gave a noncommittal answer when asked about his plans.
meanings.exampleTr: Planları sorulduğunda kesin bir şey söylemeyen bir cevap verdi.

meanings.en: the state of there not being enough of something
meanings.exampleEn: The scarceness of fresh water forced them to ration it.
meanings.exampleTr: Tatlı suyun kıtlığı, onları su tayınına başvurmaya zorladı.

meanings.en: impossible to defeat or discourage
meanings.exampleEn: She faced her illness with an indomitable spirit.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastalığıyla yılmaz bir ruhla yüzleşti.

meanings.en: silly or stupid, and not fashionable
meanings.exampleEn: He wore a dorky hat that made everyone laugh.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkesi güldüren ezik bir şapka takmıştı.

meanings.en: very fashionable or up to date
meanings.exampleEn: They ate at a trendy new restaurant downtown.
meanings.exampleTr: Şehir merkezinde moda yeni bir restoranda yemek yediler.

meanings.en: to make someone realize that a belief they hold is false
meanings.exampleEn: Let me disabuse you of the notion that this job is easy.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu işin kolay olduğu yanılgısından seni kurtarayım.

meanings.en: not defeated or brought under control
meanings.exampleEn: The highest peak remained unconquered for decades.
meanings.exampleTr: En yüksek zirve onlarca yıl fethedilmemiş kaldı.

meanings.tr: beklenenden fazlasını başaran kişi, aşırı başarılı kişi
meanings.en: someone who is more successful than expected, often working very hard
meanings.exampleEn: As an overachiever, she was never satisfied with just passing.
meanings.exampleTr: Aşırı başarılı biri olarak, sadece geçmekle asla yetinmezdi.

meanings.tr: yükselen yıldız, çok başarılı ve hırslı kişi
meanings.en: a person who is very successful or is likely to be very successful
meanings.exampleEn: She was seen as a high-flier destined for the boardroom.
meanings.exampleTr: Yönetim kuruluna kadar yükseleceği düşünülen bir yükselen yıldız olarak görülüyordu.

meanings.en: a type of paint put on a surface before the main coat
meanings.exampleEn: Apply a coat of primer before painting the wall.
meanings.exampleTr: Duvarı boyamadan önce bir kat astar sürün.

meanings.en: a book that gives the basic facts about a subject
meanings.exampleEn: This book is a useful primer on economics.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu kitap, ekonomi konusunda yararlı bir başlangıç kitabıdır.

meanings.en: an unimportant person who obeys someone more powerful without questioning them
meanings.exampleEn: The boss sent one of his minions to deliver the message.
meanings.exampleTr: Patron, mesajı iletmesi için emir kullarından birini gönderdi.

meanings.en: in poor health because of not eating enough or the right kind of food
meanings.exampleEn: Many of the refugees were severely malnourished.
meanings.exampleTr: Mültecilerin çoğu ciddi şekilde kötü beslenmişti.

meanings.en: not given enough food to eat
meanings.exampleEn: The stray dog looked thin and underfed.
meanings.exampleTr: Sokak köpeği zayıf ve yetersiz beslenmiş görünüyordu.

meanings.en: having had enough good food to eat
meanings.exampleEn: The children looked healthy and well-fed.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar sağlıklı ve iyi beslenmiş görünüyordu.

meanings.en: given too much food to eat
meanings.exampleEn: The overfed cat could barely move.
meanings.exampleTr: Fazla beslenmiş kedi neredeyse kıpırdayamıyordu.

meanings.tr: atlet, kolsuz iç fanila (özellikle İngiliz İng.)
meanings.en: a piece of clothing worn on the top part of the body, without sleeves
meanings.exampleEn: The runner wore a white singlet and shorts.
meanings.exampleTr: Koşucu beyaz bir atlet ve şort giymişti.

meanings.en: not yet used or taken advantage of
meanings.exampleEn: The region has vast untapped reserves of oil.
meanings.exampleTr: Bölgede geniş, kullanılmamış petrol rezervleri var.

meanings.en: so certain that it cannot be doubted
meanings.exampleEn: Her talent as a musician is unquestionable.
meanings.exampleTr: Müzisyen olarak yeteneği tartışılmazdır.

meanings.en: true, and impossible to doubt or argue against
meanings.exampleEn: There is indisputable evidence that he was at the scene.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun olay yerinde olduğuna dair tartışılmaz kanıtlar var.

meanings.en: likely to be wrong or not honest; that you have doubts about
meanings.exampleEn: The company used some questionable accounting methods.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket bazı şüpheli muhasebe yöntemleri kullandı.

meanings.en: calm and not upset, even in a difficult situation
meanings.exampleEn: She remained unruffled despite the chaos around her.
meanings.exampleTr: Etrafındaki kargaşaya rağmen sakin kaldı.

meanings.en: not worried or upset by something
meanings.exampleEn: He seemed unperturbed by the bad news.
meanings.exampleTr: Kötü haber karşısında istifini bozmamış görünüyordu.

meanings.en: only partly finished or completed
meanings.exampleEn: He left the project half-done when he quit.
meanings.exampleTr: İşten ayrılınca projeyi yarım bıraktı.

meanings.en: not hurt or harmed
meanings.exampleEn: The driver escaped the crash completely uninjured.
meanings.exampleTr: Sürücü kazadan hiç yaralanmadan kurtuldu.

meanings.en: having no people living there
meanings.exampleEn: They hiked through a vast, unpopulated wilderness.
meanings.exampleTr: Geniş, ıssız bir doğada yürüyüş yaptılar.

meanings.en: without being requested or invited
meanings.exampleEn: He offered his opinion, though it went unasked.
meanings.exampleTr: Sorulmamış olsa da fikrini söyledi.

meanings.en: not officially recorded on a list or with an authority
meanings.exampleEn: Driving an unregistered vehicle is illegal.
meanings.exampleTr: Tescilsiz bir araç kullanmak yasa dışıdır.

meanings.tr: eşit oldu, eşitledi (equal fiilinin geçmiş hali, İngiliz İng.)
meanings.en: past tense of equal; to be the same in amount, number, or value as something
meanings.exampleEn: She equalled the world record in her first race.
meanings.exampleTr: İlk yarışında dünya rekorunu eşitledi.

meanings.en: not interesting or exciting; lacking imagination
meanings.exampleEn: The meal was edible but completely uninspired.
meanings.exampleTr: Yemek yenilebilirdi ama tamamen sıradandı.

meanings.en: without being seen or noticed
meanings.exampleEn: He slipped out of the room unobserved.
meanings.exampleTr: Odadan fark edilmeden sıvıştı.

meanings.en: quick to notice and understand things
meanings.exampleEn: She made some perceptive comments about the film.
meanings.exampleTr: Film hakkında anlayışlı birkaç yorum yaptı.

meanings.en: copied from something else and therefore not original
meanings.exampleEn: Critics dismissed the novel as derivative and dull.
meanings.exampleTr: Eleştirmenler romanı özgün olmayan ve sıkıcı diye eleştirdi.

meanings.en: a financial product or value based on another asset or variable
meanings.exampleEn: The bank lost money trading in complex derivatives.
meanings.exampleTr: Banka, karmaşık türevlerde işlem yaparak para kaybetti.

meanings.en: used so often that it is no longer interesting or original
meanings.exampleEn: The speech was full of hackneyed phrases.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuşma, basmakalıp ifadelerle doluydu.

meanings.en: following generally accepted or traditional beliefs or methods
meanings.exampleEn: She preferred orthodox medicine to alternative therapies.
meanings.exampleTr: Alternatif tedavilere kıyasla geleneksel tıbbı tercih ediyordu.

meanings.en: better than any other of the same type
meanings.exampleEn: The museum has an unrivaled collection of ancient art.
meanings.exampleTr: Müzenin antik sanat konusunda rakipsiz bir koleksiyonu var.
